verdict.rationale: Skyvern publishes its source in a public GitHub repo (Skyvern-AI/skyvern), and its own llms.txt calls it "an open-source, AI-powered browser automation platform." A community member independently confirms the code is AGPL-3.0, an OSI-approved open license; their objection is that it is copyleft, which confirms rather than contradicts the openness. Missing for 10: a first-party statement of the license (it is identified only via community), and clarity on whether cloud-only features (e.g., the Cloud UI workflow builder) are covered by the open-source code.
